title: Create Alert
description:
Create an alert on the Collaborate Analyst Portal and publish it to the intended recipients. You can also add custom fields while creating an alert. The format to include custom fields is described in the custom field structures.

### Changelog


Supports scheduling alert expiry using scheduled_expiry_time parameter.
Added support for the share_with, reference_urls, and pirs body parameters.
Access to certain categories is based on your user role in the Analyst Portal. This update does not impact credentials generated prior to this version.


### Alert Field Types


As an analyst, you can create alerts using custom fields tailored to your needs. Use fields like text boxes for detailed input, multi-select for tagging multiple values, single-select for predefined choices, and more to customize your alerts effectively. For details on retrieving additional field information, see the Retrieve Additional Fields section. Use the table below for custom field format:
Field Type
Description
Format
Boolean
Boolean fields allow you to select either true or false for specific options. While creating an alert, you can use these fields to indicate details such as whether the alert is Publicly Shareable or Requires Immediate Action.
field_id: value
Example:
"f65b26a174658": true
Text
Text boxes allow you to add information in text format. While creating an alert, you can use these fields to provide details such as Threat Description, Likely Motivation, and more.
field_id: Text
Example:
"f533606babb44": "CVE-2014-12345"
Single-select
Single-select fields allow you to choose one option from a predefined list. These fields are used to capture key details of an alert, such as Threat Level or Severity.
field_id: { field_id_id: selected value id}
Example:
"ffa80c88f1d20": { "ffa80c88f1d20_id": "oaa822c36c133" }
Multi-select
Multi-select fields allow you to associate multiple options with an alert from a predefined list. For example, you can use these fields to assign Affected Sectors or Indicators.
field_id: [{ field_id_id: selected value id}, { field_id_id: selected value id}]
Example:
"f65b26a174658": [ { "f65b26a174658_id": "o15f317d51bec" }, { "f65b26a174658_id": "o43d57e02d92a" } ]
Date & Time
Date and time fields let you capture time-sensitive details for an alert, such as Reported At or Action Deadline. The values are stored in Epoch (Unix timestamp) format.
field_id: Epoch value
Example:
"f9c217dfe8824": 1709725603
Additional fields are system or custom fields that you can use while creating alerts. To ensure accurate field mapping, you need to retrieve the field IDs and details before passing them as body parameters. To retrieve field details, follow these steps:
1.  Use the **Get Additional Fields List** endpoint in the Alerts section to retrieve the list of all fields, including their field IDs.
2.  Use the `field_id` in the **Get Additional Fields Details** endpoint to retrieve associated field details.

body.name: title
body.description: Pass the title of the alert. Example: *New Malware Variant Targeting Enterprise Networks*
body.value: New Malware Variant Targeting Enterprise Networks

body.name: content
body.description: Pass the description of the alert.
body.value: A newly discovered malware strain is actively exploiting vulnerabilities in enterprise networks, enabling unauthorized access and data exfiltration. Organizations are advised to update security measures, monitor network traffic, and apply patches to mitigate the threat.

body.name: is_content_defanged
body.description: Pass true to specify that the link is not clickable.

body.name: card_image
body.description: Pass the URL for the alert image. Ensure that the value is a valid URL. Example: *https://cyware.com/cyware.jpg.* To pass this field, ensure the `type` field is also included.

body.name: type
body.description: Pass the type of the alert image. The current supported type is *URL*.

body.name: card_info
body.description:
Pass any additional details for the alert. Note: You can use HTML format for the additional information.
Example: Adversary:,
Malware Families: njRAT, AsyncRAT, Houdini RAT
Attack IDs: T1104, T1547",
body.value:
Adversary:,
Malware Families: njRAT, AsyncRAT, Houdini RAT
Attack IDs: T1104, T1547

body.name: card_category
body.description:
Pass the category for the alert. Example: { "category_id": "154c4d4c", "category_name": "Malware Advisory"}
Use the **Get Category List** endpoint to retrieve the list of alert categories. To assign a category to the alert, pass either the `card_category` or `card_category_name` parameter. `card_category` takes precedence if both are passed.

items.name: category_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the category. Example: *154c4d4c*

items.name: category_name
items.description: Pass the name of the category. Example: *Malware Advisory*

body.name: card_category_name
body.description:
Pass the alert category associated with your user role in the Analyst Portal. Example: *Malware*.
To assign a category, pass either the `card_category` or `card_category_name` parameters.
Note: `card_category` takes precedence if both are passed.

body.name: card_group
body.description:
Pass the list of recipient group IDs for the alert publication. You can retrieve the list of available recipient groups using the **Get Recipient Groups** endpoint. `group_id` is a required key for the recipient group.
Note: This is a required field if status is PUBLISHED.

items.name: group_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the recipient group to share the alert with. Example: *02a97aaa*.

items.name: group_name
items.description: Pass the name of the recipient group. Example: *Level 1 Analyst*.

body.name: pirs
body.description: Pass one or more comma-separated IDs of published Intelligence Requirements (IRs) to associate with the alert for enrichment. You can retrieve a list of IRs using the *Get IRs* endpoint.

items.description: Pass the ID of the published IR.

body.name: reference_urls
body.description: Pass one or more comma-separated URLs to offer additional context or information related to the alert.

items.description: Pass the reference URL to offer additional information.

body.name: defang_ioc_in_ioc_attachments
body.description: Pass true to defang the IOCs in the attachment.

body.name: threat_indicators_obj
body.description: Pass the threat indicators associated with the alert.

items.name: sha256
items.description: Pass one or more comma-separated SHA-256 values associated with the alert.

items.name: domain
items.description: Pass one or more comma-separated domains associated with the alert.
Pass one or more comma-separated domains associated with the alert.

items.name: sha1
items.description: Pass one or more comma-separated SHA-1 values associated with the alert.

items.name: md5
items.description: Pass one or more comma-separated MD5 values associated with the alert.
Pass one or more comma-separated MD5 values associated with the alert.

body.name: push_email_notification
body.description: Pass true to send email notifications to the recipients.

body.name: push_required
body.description: Pass true to send mobile notifications to the recipients.

body.name: card_organization
body.description: Pass the list of organizations for the alert publication. You can retrieve the list of available organizations using the **Get Organizations** endpoint. `organization_id` is a required key for the organization.

body.name: card_organization_types
body.description: Pass a list of organization types associated with the organizations provided using the `card_organization` for alert publication. You can retrieve the available organization types using the **Get Organizations** endpoint. The `organization_type_id` is a required key for each organization type.

body.name: tags
body.description: Pass the list of tags associated with the alert. Example: *["malware", "vulnerability"]*.

items.description: Pass the tag associated with the alert. Example: *malware*

body.name: custom_fields
body.description: Pass the custom fields linked to the alert. Custom fields may vary based on the selected alert category.

items.name: f159dc38f3255
items.description: Pass the unique identifier linked to a custom parameter. Example: *"f159dc38f3255": "Major 2"*

body.name: status
body.description:
Pass the status of the alert. Example: *PUBLISHED*
Note: You can specify the status as PUBLISHED only if you have the permission to publish alerts in the Analyst Portal.

body.name: tlp
body.description: Pass the TLP level for the alert. Example: *WHITE*

body.name: tracking_id
body.description: Pass the tracking ID generated when third-party integrations publish alerts in Collaborate. Example: *1111*

body.name: cyber_threat_method
body.description: Pass the list of associated cyber threat methods for the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: cyberthreatmethod_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the cyber threat method. Example: *de5871a7-4392-4eaa-abcd-8400ba3c6f4b*

items.name: cyber_threat_method_name
items.description: Pass the name of the cyber threat method. Example: *Defacement*

body.name: physical_threat_method
body.description: Pass the list of associated physical threat methods for the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: physicalthreatmethod_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the physical threat method. Example: *671d9692-5e87-489d-932b-17e850be42a5*

items.name: physical_threat_method_name
items.description: Pass the name of the physical threat method. Example: *Tailgating*

body.name: risk
body.description: Pass the risk level associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: risk_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the risk associated with the alert. Example: *2be4af1c-6817-443b-978b-1fcf9b407841*

items.name: risk_name
items.description: Pass the level of the risk associated with the alert. Example: *1*

body.name: urgency
body.description: Pass the urgency details related to the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: urgency_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the urgency associated with the alert. Example: *c27165be-1d39-479a-b5a1-ee7b97494fa3*

items.name: urgency_name
items.description: Pass the urgency name associated with the alert. Example: *Informational Only*

body.name: severity
body.description: Pass severity details of the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: severity_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the severity associated with the alert. Example: *b7a73f86-ae9c-45ef-94a0-e00d9ab35e2c*

items.name: severity_name
items.description: Pass the severity name associated with the alert. Example: *Informational (Normal)*

body.name: credibility
body.description: Pass the data credibility associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: credibility_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the credibility associated with the alert. Example: *940a3fe0-66cc-4c29-9d42-c3da5201328a*

items.name: credibility_name
items.description: Pass the credibility name associated with the alert. Example: *Unknown*

body.name: detectionmethod
body.description: Pass the detection methods used in the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: detectionmethod_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the detection method associated with the alert. Example: *8598be92-95b3-41c6-9017-0108a42ef203*

items.name: detectionmethod_name
items.description: Pass the name of the detection method. Example: *Alert on Console*

body.name: vendorsnproduct
body.description: Pass the list of vendors associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: vendors_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the vendor. Example: *3c98be67-3fab-481e-9b35-12ed7f6edd72*

items.name: vendorsnproduct_name
items.description: Pass the name of the vendor. Example: *Vendor Name 1*

body.name: priority
body.description: Pass the priority of details associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: priority_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the priority associated with the alert. Example: *cdff50bf-ddcf-4523-a1da-560f3674e983*

items.name: priority_name
items.description: Pass the name of the priority. Example: *3*

body.name: document_type
body.description: Pass the list of document types associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: documenttype_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the document type. Example: *3b13bb16-5098-492e-b694-cb8b9118afcd*

items.name: document_type_name
items.description: Pass the name of the document type. Example: *Compliance and Regulations*

body.name: announcement_type
body.description: Pass the announcement-type details associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: announcement_type_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the announcement type. Example: *73df5e3b-294d-4764-bd8f-edd17c46f9c8*

items.name: announcement_type_name
items.description: Pass the name of the announcement type. Example: *Internal*

body.name: info_source
body.description: Pass the list of information or intel sources associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: source_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the info source. Example: *bdc5c654*

items.name: info_source_name
items.description: Pass the name of the info source. Example: *Internal Sources*

body.name: systemsaffected
body.description: Pass the number associated with systems affected by the cyberthreat. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: systemsaffected_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the systems affected. Example: *22763904-76d9-4f02-b8bd-7294ddd81df2*

items.name: systemsaffected_name
items.description: Pass the name of the systems affected. Example: *1-10*

body.name: threat_actor
body.description: Pass the threat actors associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: threatactor_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the threat action. Example: *2ea27f3f-45c5-4239-803b-d96e86a5b346*

items.name: threat_actor_name
items.description: Pass the name of the threat actor. Example: *Cyber Criminal*

body.name: threat_method
body.description: Pass the threat methods associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: threatmethod_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the threat method. Example: *54929952-6d99-499f-89a7-41fbe528695c*

items.name: threat_method_name
items.description: Pass the name of the threat method. Example: *APT*

body.name: confidence
body.description: Pass the confidence level details associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: confidence_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the confidence level. Example: *c9d56bf4-c05a-4b67-8fae-4dd64b71e789*

items.name: confidence_name
items.description: Pass the name of the confidence level. Example: *High*

body.name: kill_chain_phase
body.description: Pass the kill chain phase details associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: kill_chain_phase_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the kill chain phase value. Example: *89a3d408-3e8a-4e7c-93f9-7a11673da2a5*

items.name: kill_chain_phase_name
items.description: Pass the name of the kill chain phase value. Example: *Actions on Objectives*

body.name: root_cause
body.description: Pass the list of root causes associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: root_cause_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the root cause associated with the alert. Example: *2ca6cce5-644d-4fff-9e0d-d2dc76707164*

items.name: root_cause_name
items.description: Pass the name of the root cause. Example: *Design Error*

body.name: reportsource
body.description: Pass the list of report sources associated with the alert. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: reportsource_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the report source associated with the alert. Example: *bda9c668-217b-42ae-be44-eacd9955b31d*

items.name: reportsource_name
items.description: Pass the name of the report source. Example: *Government Agency*

body.name: vulnerability_type
body.description: Pass the list of types of vulnerabilities. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: vulnerability_type_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the vulnerability type. Example: *4690252c-1c76-4621-bc51-314677280672*

items.name: vulnerability_type_name
items.description: Pass the name of the vulnerability type. Example: *Vulnerability 1*

body.name: vulnerability_source
body.description: Pass the list of sources of vulnerabilities. For details on retrieving the `field_id` and associated information, see the API endpoint description.

items.name: vulnerability_source_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the vulnerability source. Example: *2a2583ad-ce2f-4972-a932-6c561e70e639*

items.name: vulnerability_source_name
items.description: Pass the name of the vulnerability source. Example: *Media*

body.name: scheduled_expiry_time
body.description: Pass the expiry date and time in epoch format. The system automatically expires the alert at this exact time.

body.name: attachments
body.description: Attach relevant media to the alert. If you are passing an array of JSON objects, firstly, use the Upload File endpoint to upload the required files. The `document_id` is a required key for this field. If you are passing an array of strings, secondly, enter links to the attachments as strings.

items.name: document_id
items.description: Pass the document ID of the associated media. Example: *0af6b6f8-9709-4b39-91df-f8b616b70123*

body.name: linked_alerts
body.description: Pass the list of alert IDs (short_id) for the alerts you want to link to this alert. Use the **Get Alerts** endpoint to retrieve the `short_id`.

items.description: Specify the list of alert IDs (short_id) for the alerts you want to link to this alert.

items.name: short_id
items.description: Pass the unique ID of the alert to link to this alert. Example: *10ac09de*

body.name: share_with
body.description: Pass the details of the external applications to share the alert with.

items.name: applications
items.description: Pass the external applications to share the alert with. Allowed keys are threat_stream, ctix, misp, threat_connect, and ms_teams.

items.name: threat_stream
items.description: Pass true to share the alert with ThreatStream.

items.name: ctix
items.description: Pass true to share the alert with Cyware Intel Exchange.

items.name: misp
items.description: Pass true to share the alert with MISP.

items.name: threat_connect
items.description: Pass true to share the alert with ThreatConnect.

items.name: ms_teams
items.description: Pass a list of Microsoft Teams channel names to share the alert with.
Pass the name of the Microsoft Teams channel.

responses.description: Returns the following response paramaters upon successful alert creation.

body.name: short_id
body.description: Returns the 8-digit unique alert ID. Example: *685ca5d7*

body.name: title
body.description: Returns the title of the alert. Example: *New Malware Variant Targeting Enterprise Networks*
body.value: New Malware Variant Targeting Enterprise Networks

body.name: content
body.description: Returns the description of the alert.
body.value: A newly discovered malware strain is actively exploiting vulnerabilities in enterprise networks, enabling unauthorized access and data exfiltration. Organizations are advised to update security measures, monitor network traffic, and apply patches to mitigate the threat.

body.name: status
body.description: Returns the current status of the alert. Example: *PUBLISHED*

body.name: tlp
body.description: Returns the TLP associated with the alert. Example: *WHITE*

body.name: optional_fields
body.description: Returns all the optional fields associated with the alert.

items.name: threat_indicators
items.description: Returns the indicator details attached to the alert.
